lines.text: The psalm calls the servants who stand in the LORD's house to praise His name because He is good.
The LORD chose Jacob and Israel as His treasured possession, and He does all that pleases Him in heaven and earth.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt and also defeated Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Moab.
He gave the land of the defeated kings to Israel, and the idols of the nations are made of bronze and iron.
Idols cannot speak, see or hear, and the psalm calls Israel, Aaron, Levi and all who fear the LORD to bless Him.
